content.comment_body: Hello, my question is simple: I have an analog input linked to a pressure transmitter, and I'm able to configure on/off trigger values. Is there a method to use the Up and Down cursor keys to adjust these trigger values directly?
I'm responding to my own query. After further research, I discovered the solution. For anyone interested in similar functionality, refer to this explanation: [url]

I wrote a program using both F keys and cursor keys. When simulating in [product_name] software ([version_no]), everything works correctly. However, after transferring it to the [product_name] ([article_no]) with [product_name] TD, the cursor keys do not function properly. The application runs and F1-F4 keys operate, but pressing the cursor keys gives unexpected results—Up does nothing and Down opens the device menu. Normally, these should adjust values. I tried loading the 'Heating' program from [url], and encountered the same issue: Up and Down cursor keys aren't working as intended. Is there a configuration step I missed for the TD? I checked properties but didn't find anything specific regarding TD. Is it possible for the TD backlight to remain always on?
Try searching for 'logo cursor'. You can enable the backlight directly on the TD (refer to the manual), or activate it via software using flag M26.

Thank you; I was unaware of both M25 and M26 flags. Based on what I've read, I updated my program to use the F1 and F2 keys to increase or decrease values. This approach works more smoothly than using the cursor plus ESC.
